title: Cultural diversity, networks, and innovation in cities — replication package (Urban Innovation ABM)
description:
Replication package for the Ph.D. thesis Cultural diversity, networks, and innovation in cities: an agent-based model of co-evolutionary processes (University of Enna "Kore", defended 15 July 2026; supervisor: Prof. Raffaele Scuderi).

The package contains: the NetLogo 6.3.0 agent-based model (v5.1 specification) integrating 200 households, 20 firms, 5 universities and 5 institutions, with cultural diffusion, social and economic networks (Watts–Strogatz, Barabási–Albert) and a knowledge production function in which cultural diversity carries the highest elasticity (γ = 0.35); the NSGA-II driver (pymoo) optimising four policy levers — cultural-diffusion rate, bridging-capital weight, innovation-diffusion rate, policy effectiveness — against three objectives (innovation, cultural diversity, income Gini); the experiment configuration; and the complete output data of the three thesis runs (seeds 42, 123, 456; 4,860 simulation evaluations): three final Pareto fronts and three full evolutionary trajectories.

The README documents the verified analysis conventions needed to reproduce the thesis statistics from the archived data (Pearson correlations, CDR regime partition, knee-point identification), the reproducibility scope (statistical for the original runs; a deterministic v2 driver is included for bit-for-bit reproducible future runs), and three cosmetic errata found during independent recomputation, none affecting any conclusion.

Code is released under the MIT License; data under CC-BY-4.0.
notes: Version 1.0.0 archives the replication package exactly as it corresponds to the thesis as defended (15 July 2026). Later versions may add post-defence extensions (additional seeds, counterfactual experiments); cite the version DOI appropriate to what you use.
